title: japan-guard-price-panel: Japan's public works pay rates for traffic guards, security guards' pay and minimum wages by prefecture, 2012-2026
description:
The daily pay rates that Japan's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) sets for traffic guards (交通誘導警備員A and B) in its public works design labor rates (公共工事設計労務単価), for all 47 prefectures and every table year from FY2012 to FY2026, extracted from MLIT's yearly releases. The rates are wages for a regular 8-hour day and exclude the security company's overheads, so they are not the price a client pays. Special rates (post-earthquake rates for Iwate, Miyagi and Fukushima; FY2021 COVID-19 measure) are marked.

Version 1.1.0 adds what full-time security guards are actually paid in each prefecture, survey years 2012-2025, from the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's (MHLW) Basic Survey on Wage Structure (賃金構造基本統計調査): age, years of service, scheduled and overtime hours, June earnings with and without overtime pay, the previous year's bonuses and the estimated number of workers, by sex, with building cleaners and (to 2019) gatekeepers for comparison. MHLW changed the survey's occupation list and estimation method in 2020; the 2020-2025 figures are given both with and without position holders, the version without them matching the coverage of the years before 2020. It also adds each prefecture's minimum wage and the date each revision took effect, FY2002-FY2026, from MHLW, and keeps the monthly national job-openings figures for security occupations and all occupations from MHLW's job placement statistics (一般職業紹介状況), March 2012 to August 2026.

Includes the source files, extraction and checking code, check reports, charts and documentation.

Sources: 「公共工事設計労務単価」（国土交通省）, Public Data License 1.0; 「賃金構造基本統計調査」 and 「一般職業紹介状況（職業安定業務統計）」（厚生労働省）, e-Stat; 「地域別最低賃金改定状況」（厚生労働省）, Public Data License 1.0. Edited from the original files; not an official government product.

Dataset: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT.
